content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Law with 10 years experience in Supreme Court, Delhi Other conditions: Must be a domicile of Maharashtra State Desirable: Post-graduate degree in law, doctorate, or extra experience in handling cooperative society election matters

content_sections.heading: RASNANIPRA Panel Advocate for Supreme Court of Delhi Job Description
content_sections.text: Appearing before the Hon. Supreme Court of India, New Delhi, on behalf of the State Cooperative Election Authority and Election Officers authorized by the Authority. Presenting arguments, defending the Authority, and managing election dispute cases filed in the Supreme Court. Conducting and handling legal matters relating to cooperative election disputes, appeals, revision applications, and writ petitions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Case-wise advocate fee as prescribed by the Authority from time to time; no other financial benefits are payable.

content_sections.heading: How Will RASNANIPRA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications Interview Candidates found eligible in scrutiny will be informed about the interview date No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Passing certificate of law degree Law degree certificate Mark sheets of law degree and post-graduation if any Bar Council enrolment certificate Certificate of practicing for at least 10 years in Supreme Court Medical fitness certificate List of election matters handled and copies of court orders Bar Council of India / Maharashtra and Goa Bar Council Sanad

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RASNANIPRA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure-B). Fill in all details and attach self-attested copies of required certificates. Affix postage stamps worth Rs. 70/- on self-addressed envelope and enclose it. Submit the application by post or in person to the office before the last date. Make sure it reaches by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RASNANIPRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RASNANIPRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Panel Advocate for Supreme Court of Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RASNANIPRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-B) and send it to State Cooperative Election Authority, Maharashtra State, Pune, Ground Floor, Central Building, 5, B. J. Road, Pune - 411001, by by post or in person, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per rules/fees for panel advocates.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Law with enrolment as an advocate and minimum 10 years of practice experience in the Supreme Court of Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a domicile of Maharashtra State.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Interview. Candidates found eligible in scrutiny will be informed about the interview date. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.answer: Supreme Court, Delhi.

faq.answer: Passing certificate of law degree; Law degree certificate; Mark sheets of law degree and post-graduation if any; Bar Council enrolment certificate; Certificate of practicing for at least 10 years in Supreme Court; Medical fitness certificate.

faq.answer: Applicants who applied previously against earlier advertisements must apply afresh.
